_producer: src/2.3.retrieval_papers_rrf.py (save_json with payload built in main)
_producer_notes: Writes top-level dict to archive/${RUN_DATE}/retrieval/rrf/${RUN_DATE}.json with keys: top_k, generated_at, papers, queries. 'papers' is {id, source, title, abstract, authors, primary_category, categories, published, link, tags}; 'queries' contains fused entries with {type, tag, paper_tag, query_text, sim_scores: {paper_id: {score, rank}}}. There is no 'final_results' field on the producer.
